page.overview:
Who is Colorful Brachiosaurus?

The colorful Brachiosaurus is a genetically modified hybrid of Brachiosaurus and tree frog that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

A colorful variant of the Brachiosaurus can be created in the game. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Brachiosaurus DNA; 2 samples of any Huge DNA; and 1 sample of Tree Frog DNA.
